note.simple: Sent through the air. Only the access point and {yours} listen for it.
note.technical: Every frame is acknowledged by the receiver (often in blocks), and lost ones are resent. The payload is encrypted (WPA3).

fc.name: Frame control
fc.about: Type (QoS data), direction (to or from the wired network, DS) and a Protected bit: the payload is encrypted.

duration.name: Duration
duration.about: How long the air is booked for this frame and its acknowledgement.

addr1.about: Who on the air should take this frame.

addr2.about: Who sent it over the air.

addr3.name: Addr 3
addr3.about: The far end on the wired side: the AP copies it into the Ethernet frame it bridges to.

seq.name: Sequence control
seq.about: Spots duplicates when a frame is resent.

qos.name: QoS control
qos.about: Traffic class (WMM): video gets a faster queue.

ccmp.name: CCMP header
ccmp.about: Packet number for the WPA3 encryption of everything inside.

snap.name: LLC/SNAP
snap.about: Says what is inside, like an EtherType.

fcs.name: Frame check sequence
fcs.about: A CRC over the frame: a damaged one is resent.

note.technical: Every frame is acknowledged by the receiver (often in blocks), and lost ones are resent. The payload is encrypted (WPA2).

ccmp.about: Packet number for the WPA2 encryption of everything inside.
